transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this meeting to address the 1,200 cast aluminum housings currently on hold due to cosmetic residue from the forming operation. Before I can authorize any rework and release the campaign plan, we need to go through our standard pre-authorization review. I'd like to hear from each of you -- process engineering, maintenance, quality, and EHS -- on whether the ultrasonic cleaning cell is ready and capable of handling this rework, and what inspection and documentation we'll need before release. Let's start with process engineering: can you walk us through what's needed?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share an important finding from a process trial I completed yesterday. The trial showed that the residue can be successfully removed from only 900 of the 1,200 housings using the ultrasonic cleaning cell. The remaining 300 housings have embedded residue that cannot be removed by this method, and they will have to remain on hold. I have not yet entered this result in the production release system, so I wanted to make sure everyone here is aware before we proceed with planning the rework campaign.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a maintenance issue before we go any further. During my weekly walkdown of the ultrasonic cleaning cell, I found that the circulation-pump seal needs to be replaced before the cell can be used. This will require exactly 4 hours of planned downtime. I identified the issue but have not yet opened the maintenance work order, so I'm making everyone aware now so we can factor this into the campaign timeline.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share an important update from the customer side. This morning I received a revised plan from the customer portal, and I confirmed in the customer control plan that every reworked housing must receive dimensional scanning. Additionally, the plan requires exactly 30 reworked housings to be retained for customer review. I have not yet updated our local inspection instruction to reflect these requirements, so I'm making everyone aware now so we can factor dimensional scanning capacity and the 30-piece retention into our campaign planning.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Before we finalize the rework campaign plan, I need to share an important EHS finding from my waste review. The spent cleaning solution from this campaign must be collected in exactly 2 sealed waste totes and shipped under a waste manifest. I confirmed the classification with our site's waste contractor this week, but I have not yet updated the area waste-board notice. I'm making everyone aware now so we can factor the waste handling requirements into our campaign planning.
transcript.speaker: A5
